Arrays from raw bytes, text, functions or iterators

Source: R/numpy_array.R
jnp_frombuffer.Rd

jnp_frombuffer ports jnp.frombuffer for an R raw vector (little endian, as NumPy on common platforms); jnp_fromstring ports jnp.fromstring (text mode, sep is required; whitespace around separators is ignored). jnp_fromfunction ports jnp.fromfunction: function is called once with index arrays built by nested vmap (further arguments in ... are passed unmapped). jnp_fromfile and jnp_fromiter raise errors, as in JAX.

Usage

jnp_frombuffer(buffer, dtype = "float", count = -1L, offset = 0L)

jnp_fromstring(string, dtype = "float", count = -1L, sep)

jnp_fromfunction(`function`, shape, ..., dtype = "float")

jnp_fromfile(...)

jnp_fromiter(...)

Arguments

buffer

Raw vector.

dtype

Dtype of the data ("float" is float64 before canonicalization).

count

Number of items (-1 for all).

offset

Number of bytes to skip.

string

Character scalar.

sep

Separator.

function

Function of the index arrays.

shape

Integer vector.

...

Further arguments to function; ignored by jnp_fromfile and jnp_fromiter.

Value

An array.
